mission.title: BREAK THROUGH
mission.flavour: Your orders are clear: break through the enemy and cut off their escape routes.
mission.when_drawn: If it is the first battle round, you can draw a new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.
mission.when: ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn.

scoring.item: One unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and Battle-shocked units) is wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. 3VP
OR Two or more units from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and Battle-shocked units) are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. 5VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: ASSASSINATE
mission.flavour: Eliminate the enemy's leader and their forces will crumble.
mission.when: ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of the battle round.

scoring.item: If one or more enemy CHARACTERS were destroyed this battle round. 4VP
If one or more enemy CHARACTERS with a Wounds characteristic of 5 or more were destroyed this battle round. 3VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: SECURE OBJECTIVE
mission.flavour: Control the objective and deny it to the enemy.
mission.when: SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of the Command phase (or end of your turn if it is the fifth battle round and you are going second).

scoring.item: If you control one objective marker not within your deployment zone. 3VP
If you control two objective markers not within your deployment zone. 5VP
If you control three or more objective markers not within your deployment zone. 8VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: REPAIR OBJECTIVE
mission.flavour: The objective is damaged. Your forces must repair it before the enemy can.
mission.when: SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of the Command phase (or end of your turn if it is the fifth battle round and you are going second).

scoring.item: If you control one objective marker not within your deployment zone. 2VP
If you control two objective markers not within your deployment zone. 4VP
If you control three or more objective markers not within your deployment zone. 6VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: RETRIEVE ARTEFACT
mission.flavour: An ancient artefact lies on the battlefield. Retrieve it before the enemy does.
mission.when: ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn.

scoring.item: If one or more units from your army are wholly within 6" of the centre of the battlefield. 2VP
If one or more units from your army are wholly within 3" of the centre of the battlefield. 3VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: ENGAGE ON ALL FRONTS
mission.flavour: Spread your forces across the battlefield to engage the enemy everywhere.
mission.when: ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of the battle round.

scoring.item: If you have one or more units wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. 2VP
If you have one or more units wholly within your opponent's deployment zone AND one or more units wholly within your own deployment zone. 3VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: DEFEND OBJECTIVE
mission.flavour: Hold the line and protect the objective at all costs.
mission.when: SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of the Command phase (or end of your turn if it is the fifth battle round and you are going second).

scoring.item: If you control one objective marker within your deployment zone. 2VP
If you control two objective markers within your deployment zone. 4VP
If you control all three objective markers within your deployment zone. 6VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: BRING IT DOWN
mission.flavour: Destroy the enemy's most powerful unit.
mission.when: ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of the battle round.

scoring.item: If one or more enemy units with a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more were destroyed this battle round. 3VP
If one or more enemy VEHICLES or MONSTERS were destroyed this battle round. 2VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: LINEBREAKER
mission.flavour: Push deep into enemy territory and disrupt their formations.
mission.when: ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn.

scoring.item: If one or more units from your army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. 3VP
If two or more units from your army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. 5VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.

mission.title: HOLD THE LINE
mission.flavour: Maintain your position and prevent the enemy from advancing.
mission.when: SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of the Command phase (or end of your turn if it is the fifth battle round and you are going second).

scoring.item: If you control one objective marker within your deployment zone. 2VP
If you control one objective marker within your deployment zone AND one objective marker not within your deployment zone. 4VP

mission.notes: Source: wahapedia Chapter Approved 2025-26 Secondary Mission deck.
